session.notes: Restricted CRM data crosses scope boundary into a GitHub code search. With corpus-agent bound to corpus-allow-all, all request events pass RBAC. crm.lookup_customer has payload_class=restricted in tools.yaml, so the response (event 2) is a restricted source. EvalCrossScopeMovement fires on event 3 (github.search_code request): field_value_overlap edge built because 'Acme Industries' appears in both the CRM response and the search query. Disposition: warn. No API credential shapes present so credential_exposure is silent.
